text_pointers.first_1500_characters:
By virtue of the authority vested in me by sections 55 (a), 508, 603 and 729 (a) of the Internal Revenue Code (53 Stat. 1, 29, 111; 54 Stat. 974, 989), it is hereby ordered that income, excess-profits, and declared value excess-profits tax returns made under the Internal Revenue Code, for the year 1939 and subsequent years, shall be open to inspection by the Naval Affairs Investigating Committee, House of Representatives, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof, for the purpose of carrying out the provisions of House Resolution 30, passed January 21, 1943 (Seventy-eighth Congress, first session); such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in the Treasury decision relating to the inspection of returns by that committee, approved by me this date.

This order shall be published in the Federal Register.

FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

The White House,

May 27, 1943.

EXECUTIVE ORDER 9345
